title: Megabonk
genre: Action roguelite / 3D 'survivors-like' (auto-attack horde survival, Vampire Survivors in 3D with jumping/sliding)
release_date: 2025-09-18 (Steam, Windows + Linux) [CONFIRMED – Steam store/SteamDB; originally planned for 2025-09-04, moved to avoid Hollow Knight: Silksong]
early_access_date: n/a (launched as full release, v1.0.x; free Steam demo app 3520070 published 2025-02-21 [CONFIRMED – SteamDB])
team_size: 1 (solo) [CONFIRMED – dev statements; press: Game Developer, PC Gamer, GamesRadar]
country: no data (developer is pseudonymous; see notes on unconfirmed identity speculation)
developer_background: Not a first game: in Nov 2025 vedinad said 'I've made games in the past under different studio names, so Megabonk is not my debut game' and withdrew from The Game Awards 2025 'Best Debut Indie Game' category; Geoff Keighley described him as 'an established solo developer who had been presenting himself as a new creator under the name Vedinad' [CONFIRMED – dev X post + Keighley statement via Game Informer, VGC, PC Gamer]. Earlier titles/studios not officially named. Widely reported but UNCONFIRMED fan theory (Wikipedia, Windows Central, Sportskeeda): 'vedinad' is 'DaniDev' spelled backwards, i.e. the YouTuber-developer behind Karlson, Muck and Crab Game; vedinad declined to answer when Eurogamer asked. Ran a YouTube devlog channel (@Vedinad); devlog #1 'I'm Making Vampire Survivors but 3D' (2025-02-26) is the channel's most-viewed video.
platforms_and_store_links: Steam (Windows, Linux): https://store.steampowered.com/app/3405340/Megabonk/ ; Demo: https://steamdb.info/app/3520070/info/ ; No console/mobile/macOS release as of 2026-09-21 [fan FAQ megabonk.org; dev said ports are 'possible' but he lacks console-porting experience – Gamepressure]. 'Gigabonk' on Switch eShop is an unrelated knockoff (Gamepressure). Soundtrack DLC released 2025-10-29 [SteamDB].
business_model: premium $9.99, 15% launch discount ($8.49); frequent sales 15–40% off; soundtrack DLC; no MTX
units_or_downloads: 1,000,000+ copies by 2025-10-02 (~2 weeks after launch) [CONFIRMED – vedinad X post, via Game Developer/PC Gamer/GamesRadar]; ~1.3M by early Oct 2025 [ESTIMATE – Video Game Insights]; ~5.3M copies by ~Aug–Sep 2026, range 4.8M–6.3M [ESTIMATE – Boxleiter: ~105,733 reviews × 50 (range 45–60); multiplier chosen from the cheap/viral band and conservative vs. the 57–67 implied launch ratio]; tracker cross-checks: ~5.27M (Steam Page Analyzer, ~100.3k reviews, 2026), ~5.1M (GameRevenueData, ~96.8k reviews), ~2.7M (Raijin, Jul–Aug 2026 – outlier). No official milestone after 1M found.
peak_concurrent_players: 117,336 on 2025-10-05 [CONFIRMED – Steam API data via SteamDB, reported by Notebookcheck/Outlook Respawn]; beat Hades II's all-time Steam peak (112,947). SteamCharts/Raijin list 116,969 (sampling difference). ~6,170 live / ~8,196 24h peak at an undated 2026 SteamDB snapshot [ESTIMATE – SteamDB category chart].
steam_reviews: ~105,733 total, 94% positive (Raijin, ~Jul–Sep 2026); 101,326 at 95% (SteamPulse, 2026); ~55–58k English reviews at 93–94% 'Very Positive'. Launch-era: ~14.9k at 94% (~2025-10-03, Game World Observer); ~23k at 92% (~2025-10-05, Notebookcheck); 24,412 at 94% (Outlook Respawn, early Oct 2025).
implied_review_multiplier: ~57–67 (1,000,000 confirmed units on 2025-10-02 ÷ ~14.9k reviews on ~2025-10-03 ≈ 67; VGI 1.3M ÷ ~23k reviews ≈ 57). Typical of a sub-$10 viral game.
gross_revenue: ~$40M (range $36M–$47M) by ~Sep 2026 [ESTIMATE – 5.3M units (4.8–6.3M) × $7.49 avg realised price ($9.99 × 0.75)]. Tracker estimates: $22.4M (Raijin, Aug 2026), $38.5M (GameRevenueData), $35.1M–$70.1M (Steam Page Analyzer range). At the confirmed 1M mark (2025-10-02): ~$7.5M gross [ESTIMATE].
net_revenue: ~$27M (range $25M–$32M) [ESTIMATE – Steam tiered cut: 30% on first $10M, 25% on $10M–$50M; × 0.93 for refunds]. Self-published, so no publisher split. GameRevenueData's own net estimate: $23.7M.
production_cost: ~$40k–$80k equivalent [ESTIMATE – 1 dev × ~12–13 months × $3k–$6k/mo; this is an opportunity cost, the dev was self-funded; no disclosed budget]. Cash costs were likely small (Unity, asset/audio work done by the dev; Steam fee $100).
development_time: ~11–13 months (start ~Aug–Oct 2024 → release 2025-09-18) [ESTIMATE – Wikipedia gives Aug 2024 start; a Feb 2025 devlog said '4 months so far' (via TweakTown); Eneba write-up: 'around a year']. Dev admitted in a YouTube video that the game was 'not nearly finished' 3 weeks before the original 2025-09-04 date.
why_popular: Takes the proven Vampire Survivors dopamine loop (auto-attacks, escalating builds, screen-filling hordes) into 3D with movement skill (jumping, sliding, bunny-hopping), absurd 'grow absurdly powerful' builds and meme humour (Megachad etc.). Extremely clip-friendly (chaotic late-game screens), low $9.99 price, short runs, 21 characters + unlocks for long-term grind. Dev's personality/devlogs created a parasocial fanbase; the anonymous-identity mystery and Game Awards withdrawal generated extra press.
marketing_channels: YouTube devlogs (Devlog #1 Feb 2025 went viral) + TikTok dev updates; free Steam demo from Feb 2025 with Discord/Steam-forum feedback loop; heavy streamer/YouTuber coverage at launch (e.g. German streamer HandOfBlood); Steam top-seller placement after launch; word of mouth; low price; launch date shifted to avoid Silksong and kept despite 'delay again' advice; Game Awards nomination/withdrawal news cycle (Nov 2025). Tracker wishlist estimate ~708k (Jul 2026, third-party, unverified).
engine: Unity (IL2CPP) [CONFIRMED – SteamDB file/SDK detection on the demo; Wikipedia infobox]
art_style: Simple low-poly 3D, bright saturated colours, goofy/crude meme characters and props, readable silhouettes; deliberately lo-fi ('you don't need fancy graphics', Dataconomy).
ai_feasibility_justification: AI can: write most gameplay code (wave spawner, auto-attack weapons, upgrade/stat system, procedural arena layout, save/unlock meta-progression) with Claude Code; generate low-poly characters/props (Meshy/Tripo) or kitbash from cheap low-poly packs; SFX (ElevenLabs), music (Suno/Udio), item text. AI cannot: the 'feel' of movement (slide/jump momentum), balancing hundreds of item/weapon interactions so builds feel broken-but-fun, performance tuning for hundreds of enemies (GPU instancing/ECS-style pooling), a personality-driven devlog/TikTok audience, and luck of virality. Real game took an experienced solo dev ~1 year; with AI a smaller-content clone-in-spirit is 1–3 months for a solid MVP, but reaching Megabonk's polish/content takes much longer. | Toolset: Claude Code + Unity 6 (or Godot 4 with GodotSteam) + Steamworks.NET, Meshy/Tripo for 3D, Synty-style low-poly asset packs, Mixamo animations, ElevenLabs SFX, Suno music, OBS/CapCut for TikTok devlogs.
solo_ai_mvp_cost_time: 6–10 weeks, ~$300–$900 (Claude Max $100–$200/mo, 3D gen $20–$60/mo, low-poly asset packs $50–$300, ElevenLabs/Suno ~$30/mo, Steam Direct $100). Excludes developer living costs.
solo_ai_polished_cost_time: 6–12 months, ~$3,000–$12,000 (tools ~$250/mo, asset packs $300–$800, freelance VFX/UI/character polish $1k–$6k, playtests + creator keys/marketing $500–$3k, Steam fee $100). Excludes developer living costs.

data_conflicts: Total units: Raijin ~2.7M (Jul–Aug 2026, implies only ~25 copies/review) vs Steam Page Analyzer ~5.27M and GameRevenueData ~5.1M; chose ~5.3M (×50) because the confirmed launch calibration gives 57–67 copies/review, so ×25 looks too low; kept a wide 4.8–6.3M range. Peak CCU: 117,336 (SteamDB) vs 116,969 (SteamCharts/Raijin) – used SteamDB. Price: one outlet cited $5.49 (a sale/regional price); list is $9.99. Release date: one source says Sept 19 (time-zone), Steam says Sept 18. Dev start: Aug 2024 (Wikipedia) vs ~Oct 2024 implied by Feb 2025 'four months so far' devlog. A June 2026 games.gg article claiming 'approaching 500k sales' is stale/inconsistent and ignored. Search budget for this agent ran out before re-checking a Gamalytic figure.
notes: Strongest solo-dev case study in the window: ~1 year solo, Unity, simple low-poly art, $9.99, ~$25–32M estimated net. Key replicable levers: (1) pick a proven loop and add one twist (3D + movement); (2) build in public with devlog videos whose titles pitch the hook ('Vampire Survivors but 3D'); (3) early free demo + Discord feedback; (4) cheap price for impulse/gift buys; (5) dodge mega-launch weeks. Post-launch: Spooky update (new character Roberto, Graveyard map, bosses), Christmas patch (v1.0.49), 'H A T S' update v1.0.64 (Jan 2026, 21 hats, save-recovery via Steam achievements), hotfix v1.0.69 (Feb 2026). No native co-op (community mods exist; dev 'no promises'), no console ports as of Sept 2026. Beware of knock-offs (Gigabonk, Megabonk Apocalypse by TinyBig is unrelated). The DaniDev identity link is unconfirmed speculation – do not present it as fact.
